You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from the 2016 NSW HSC Business Studies exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 23(c) [4 marks]: Heather's workforce is diverse and culturally competent.
What are the advantages of this for Heather's business?
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Heather owns a financial planning business with offices in four countries, including Australia.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Gives two reasons how and/or why Heather's business will benefit from a diverse culturally competent workforce
3 marks: Gives one reason how and/or why Heather's business will benefit from a diverse culturally competent workforce and sketches in general terms another benefit
2 marks: Gives one reason how and/or why Heather's business will benefit from a diverse culturally competent workforce OR sketches in general terms two benefits
1 marks: Sketches in general terms one benefit

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
• Employees will know different languages and have knowledge of different cultures, which could be used constructively to open up markets in other parts of the world. They may also have contacts in other countries that could be used as sources of supplies, finance or to set up branches of the company.
• The business can get ideas and input from employees of different backgrounds. They will bring different training and approaches that could be beneficial to the firm.




STUDENT RESPONSE:
"""

Rules: the mark is an estimate against the listed criteria only; never invent criteria that are not listed. Quote the student's own words as evidence for every mark you award. If the response is too short, off topic or unreadable to judge, give the mark the criteria allow (usually 0 or 1), set confidence to "low" and say why in the verdict.

Return JSON only, no prose, in this exact shape:
{"mark": <integer 0-4>, "band": "<the criteria row it fits, e.g. '4'>", "verdict": "<one sentence saying why it got that mark>", "evidence": ["<up to 3 short quotes, under 15 words each, taken word for word from the student's response, that earned marks; [] if none>"], "strengths": ["<up to 3 short points>"], "missing": ["<up to 3 elements the criteria row above this one needs and the response lacks>"], "improvements": ["<up to 3 concrete things to add or change to reach the next row, each under 25 words>"], "next": "<the single most useful next action for this student, under 20 words>", "confidence": "<high, medium or low>", "model": "<a full-mark answer in 2 to 5 plain sentences a student could realistically write in the exam>"}
